metadata.title: Inscribed 4-polytopes of maximal volume with seven and eight vertices
metadata.abstract: We prove, with sum-of-squares certificates checked in exact arithmetic, that every cyclic $4$-polytope with seven vertices inscribed in $\mathbb{S}^{3}$ has volume at most $2/5$. Hence no $4$-polytope of maximal volume with seven vertices inscribed in $\mathbb{S}^{3}$ is cyclic, answering a question of Horváth and Lángi for $d = 4$, and with their theorem the maximal volume is $\sqrt{3}/4$. With eight vertices, the same method bounds the volume of every simplicial type other than the cross-polytope by $13/20$, so the regular cross-polytope, of volume $2/3$, is up to orthogonal transformations the unique maximiser.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 利用精确算术检验的平方和证书，排除七顶点循环四维多面体达到最大体积，结合已有结果得到最优值 √3/4；八顶点则证明正交叉多面体为唯一最优者，体积2/3。
analysis.breakthrough: 确定两组有限顶点约束下的四维球内接体积最优模型。
analysis.limitations: 七顶点排除循环型的证明与最终最优值依赖的既有定理应区分；计算证书属于证明的一部分。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 AI 协助数学讨论、代码实现、文字起草修订和对照来源核查引文；方法由作者提出，证明依赖引用结果与精确验证器检查的证书。本次未独立重跑证书。
